notes.title: Hotfix Astronauts, bots, resources
notes.notes: Hotfix for Astronauts, conveyor belt resources and transport bots

notes.title: Photo Mode and bug fixes
notes.notes:
This update adds photo mode to the game, so taking screenshots is now way easier.
You can hide interface, weapon, use virtual camera and capture different resolutions from 2k to 8k!
In addition many bug fixes for Astronauts, oxygen barriers and many other.

notes.title: Thrusters, Dirt, Barn / Farm tooltips and bugfixes
notes.notes:
In this update, Thrusters got reworked. Each thruster can now go directly up and down, so it's possible to create as pace elevator! There is also a new resource DIRT - mined on planets, required when placing a new voxel. Other changes:

- Fixed issues with control panel not setting thrusters correct direction 
- Animals and plants tooltips added
- Farm, Barn, Mine shows produced resources in details panel
- fixed an issue where dirt can be placed to generate infinite Quartz or Stone
- fixed an issue where pipe resource is blocked by near devices
- fixed an issue with splitting resources 1000 and more

notes.title: Last update in 2021!
notes.notes:
Hello Colonizers! This update is addressed to fix crashes and remaining bugs. Check list below:
- Astronauts should not block themselves
- Human needs and navigation improved
- Saving Planets no longer makes them disappear
- Rover excavator works on every planet
- Visited planets list now can be scrolled
- More Uranium Ore and other balance changes
- Pillar don't cause crash anymore
- Pipes are bend when loaded
- Logic block no longer forces resources to get our of a building
- Pinned tech points are now saved
- Visible resources are now saved
- Nuclear plants has a cost
- Space Station speed is scaled with a game speed
Many other fixes, missing textures and typos.

notes.title: Christmas update
notes.notes:
Merry Christmas everyone!
Below changes you can find in the update:
- Planets no longer disappear when flying far away
- No more visual artifacts when Base Warehouse is removed 
- Foundation Bottom block can be rotated
- Farm has no longer a grain bag inside
- Remove All button is now gone

notes.title: Hotfix #4
notes.notes:
Update fixing some remaining issues is here. Fixed:
- mine (structure) no longer resets selected resource on Load
- Breeder recipe unlocks in the tech tree
- Titanium Rod unlocks in the tech tree
- Steel Screws unlocks in the tech tree
- Boundaries corrected for a control panel device
- Scientist and Cook previews visible in the Kitchen and Laboratory
- unlimited points 999 allow to access every technology in the tree

notes.title: More changes and fixes!
notes.notes:
- Humans work nicely with redesigned pathfinding and new human needs.
- Swapping conveyor belts is no longer an issue
- Medium and Big thruster effect is back
- Glass can be pushed out and has new movement effect
- Redesigned tech tree
- Hangar no longer should cause issues when going out
- Water cells can store water, but there is no gap between
- Astronauts no longer registered multiple time in the Astronauts screen (L)
- Excavator load problem is gone
- E to close Device Menu

notes.title: Hotfix #3
notes.notes:
Many fixes are coming to the game:
- green colliders should always allow constructing inside
- asteroid catcher upgrade fixed
- fixed missing technologies & recipes (ex. Gold Plate)
- conveyor ramp fixed
- Pusher / Splitter no longer filters resources for a device
- New pathfinding for humans with swapping mechanic - so they should never lock each other
- Origin for bot fixed, so it can follow the player endlessly

notes.title: Hotfix #1
notes.notes: Changed the default key binding for Inventory  and Resources [J].
